from pathlib import Path
from rich.console import Console
from geolab_kb_ingest.config import get_settings
from geolab_kb_ingest.db import get_engine, init_db
from geolab_kb_ingest.embedder import Embedder
from geolab_kb_ingest.ingestor import ingest_all

console = Console\(force_terminal=False\)
settings = get_settings\(\)
engine = get_engine\(settings.database_url\)
init_db\(engine\)
embedder = Embedder\(
    api_key=settings.voyage_api_key,
    model=settings.voyage_model,
    batch_size=settings.voyage_batch_size,
    dims=settings.embedding_dims,
\)

stats = ingest_all\(
    Path\('C:/Dev/BR_Agent/remote-sensing'\),
    engine, embedder, True, console,
    max_tokens=settings.chunk_max_tokens,
\)
print\(f'Done - {stats[\\"total_chunks\\"]} chunks from {stats[\\"total_packages\\"]} packages.'\)
if stats['errors']:
    print\(f'{len\(stats[\\"errors\\"]\)} errors:'\)
    for e in stats['errors']:
        print\(f'  {e}'\)
" 2>&1)
